name: Derrick M. Anderson
desc: American politician, lawyer and military officer (born 1984)
summary: Derrick M. Anderson (born August 4, 1984) is an American politician, lawyer, and military officer. He serves as Assistant Secretary of Defense for Special Operations and Low-Intensity Conflict since his confirmation on December 18, 2025. He is previously the Republican Party nominee for Virginia's 7th congressional district in 2024 election.
